name: java-empty-module-subtree-fails-the-frontend
body: A `--module` root naming an existing directory that contains no `.java` file yields a zero-length walk, and the pre-existing full-scan path then fails the frontend with javac's `error: no source files` (the driver reports and skips the language) instead of emitting an empty stream; upgrade when a selected-but-empty subtree must emit an empty stream rather than fail the frontend process.
